header.name: Lia J
header.title: Full Stack Engineer | Principal Full Stack Engineer | Software Architect
header.bio: Full Stack Engineer and Software Architect with 14.5+ years of experience designing, developing, and optimizing scalable web applications across e-commerce, SaaS, education, enterprise, aviation, gaming, and digital media domains. Strong hands-on experience across frontend and backend development using Angular, React, Vue, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, Express.js, Python, RESTful APIs, MongoDB, and MySQL. Experienced in designing modular application architectures, reusable UI components, backend services, API integrations, database solutions, performance optimization, testing, and CI/CD. Proven ability to lead engineering teams, translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
